title: False promises leaving foreboding feelings
subtitle: A personal study of Neo-Expressionism — and what happens when you read it through a contemporary lens.
seo_title: Neo-Expressionism Cyberpunk: False Promises and Foreboding Feelings
seo_description: A charged portrait series blending neo-expressionist marks with surreal atmosphere and cyberpunk industrial textures—glow, glitch, and high contrast emotion.
thumb_alt: Angular portraits with glitch artifacts, industrial palettes, and charged expressionist marks.

media_alt: Neo-expressionist portraits with surreal overtones and cyberpunk industrial cues: glowing eyes, glitch textures, and high contrast color fields.
tiles: The pieces I kept for their honesty
challenge: Neo-Expressionism is a movement I keep coming back to — it's messy, it's emotional, it wears everything on the surface. I wanted to understand why it still feels current, and why pairing it with the visual language of our own moment made a certain kind of sense to me.
approach: I read into the movement and the painters who defined it, then drafted variations that let the gesture and feeling come first. The contemporary cues — the glow, the small electric details — came in because they felt true to how the mood of that kind of work lands now.
result: The pieces I kept are the ones that felt honest and a little unsettling in a way I liked. They're available as prints in case anyone else finds the same charged stillness in them.
